fact: On 12 July 2024 the ministry's agency ANICNS handed computers, three hospital information systems and internet connections to the Centre Mère et Enfant de Ngaba, the Lufungula general hospital and the Lufungula health centre in Kinshasa, to implement the first SIH modules and guarantee portability of the computerised patient record; the initiative is financed from the Congolese government's own funds and is to extend to more than a hundred Kinshasa facilities.
title: A Kinshasa, l’ANICNS dote trois établissements hospitaliers de kits médicaux digitalisés pour notamment garantir la portabilité du dossier patient informatisé
